questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答}\;\; \mathrm{L}: \begin{cases}x=R\cos t\\y=R\sin t,\end{cases}\quad\text{其中} \; t \in (\pi,2\pi),\quad\text{于是}\\&\mathrm{I}=\int_{\pi}^{2\pi} \bigl(R\cos t+2R\sin t\bigr) \bullet \sqrt{\bigl(R\cos t\bigr)^2+\bigl(R\sin t\bigr)^2}\; dt=\int_{0}^{2\pi} R^2 \bigl(\cos t+2\sin t\bigr) dt\end{aligned}
